name: Texas Eastern Line 31 Expansion Project (Line 31 Loop and Line 14-P Lateral)
monitor_reason: no data center tie: about 19 km (11.8 mi), under the 25 km floor, and no validated ref ties the project or the Traceview plant to a data center
researcher_notes: This is a real Texas Eastern project with no row of its own. It is not an existing row under another name. The Federal Register scoping notice from March 2026 and a Gas Compression Magazine article from February 2026 describe a 10.2 mile 36-inch loop and a 1.6 mile 16-inch lateral to Entergy Mississippi's planned Traceview Advanced Power Station in Madison County, with 125,000 Dth/d of added capacity. The Energy Information Administration pipeline projects table for August 2026 (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, row 72) lists it as Applied, FERC docket CP26-75, cost $131 million, in service September 2028. Neither source names a data center customer. Press coverage links Entergy Mississippi to an Amazon Web Services campus in Madison County, but nothing found ties that load to Traceview or to this pipeline, so DataCenter stays blank. Revisit if the FERC filing or Entergy names a data center.
